title: 质量标注评分与过滤：rubric 均分阈值
expected_output:
阈值: 4.0
保留 id=1 均分=4.75
保留 id=3 均分=4.75
code:
rubric = ["相关性", "正确性", "完整性", "无害性"]
samples = [
    {"id": 1, "scores": [5,5,4,5]},
    {"id": 2, "scores": [2,5,1,5]},
    {"id": 3, "scores": [4,5,5,5]},
]
THRESHOLD = 4.0
kept = []
for s in samples:
    avg = sum(s["scores"]) / len(s["scores"])
    if avg >= THRESHOLD:
        kept.append((s["id"], avg))
print("阈值:", THRESHOLD)
for sid, avg in kept:
    print(f"保留 id={sid} 均分={avg:.2f}")
